lines.say: [gravelly, tired] The Emperor has been sitting there for TEN THOUSAND YEARS.
lines.text: THE EMPEROR HAS BEEN SITTING THERE FOR TEN THOUSAND YEARS.

lines.say: [deadpan] Keeping the light on. Every ship steers home by it.
lines.text: KEEPING THE LIGHT ON. EVERY SHIP STEERS HOME BY IT.

lines.say: [cocky] That's it? I could do that.
lines.text: THAT'S IT? I COULD DO THAT.

lines.say: [grim] A thousand psykers are fed to the Throne. Every. Single. Day.
lines.text: A THOUSAND PSYKERS ARE FED TO THE THRONE. EVERY. SINGLE. DAY.

lines.say: [coldly] The Emperor protects, Private. Do not ask what it costs.
lines.text: THE EMPEROR PROTECTS, PRIVATE. DO NOT ASK WHAT IT COSTS.

lines.say: [quietly] He's been sitting so long... he must be so tired.
lines.text: HE'S BEEN SITTING SO LONG... HE MUST BE SO TIRED.

lines.say: [sheepish] ...Can I take a shift? Sit for him?
lines.text: ...CAN I TAKE A SHIFT? SIT FOR HIM?

lines.say: [dry, unimpressed] Denied. You would last fifteen hours.
lines.text: DENIED. YOU WOULD LAST FIFTEEN HOURS.

hum: Deep low mystical choir hum swelling, golden machine drone
zap: Electric crackle and zap of psychic energy, short
puff: Man exhales a long puff of cigar smoke, slow breath
page: Comic book page turning quickly, paper whoosh
whoosh: Quick soft camera whoosh swipe transition

music: Slow melancholy gothic choir and low cello, sad then darkly comic, sparse, instrumental, no vocals, 70 bpm
